links.plain: wakefulness relay where caffeine blocks sleep-pressure docking ports
links.function: antagonizes adenosine receptors so ascending arousal signals stay elevated past bedtime
links.narration_bridge: Grounded in Reichert, Deboer & Landolt's (2022, SRC4) adenosine-caffeine receptor synthesis.

links.plain: central sleep pacemaker knocked out of smooth slow-wave rhythm
links.function: fails to lock into synchronized deep NREM delta oscillations, fragmenting recovery waves
links.narration_bridge: Drives the flattened 1/f slope and reduced NREM slow-wave synchrony in Thölke et al. (2025, SRC1).

links.plain: front thinking cortex trapped in wired criticality while you lie unconscious
links.function: fires complex, wake-like irregular patterns during NREM sleep instead of resting deeply
links.narration_bridge: Directly measured in 40 sleeping adults by Thölke, Carrier & Jerbi (2025, Communications Biology, SRC1).

links.plain: master body clock pushed 40 minutes later by evening caffeine
links.function: shifts endogenous melatonin timing backward when caffeine arrives late in the day
links.narration_bridge: Demonstrated in humans in vivo by Burke et al. (2015, Science Translational Medicine, SRC6).
